name: agentic-context-engine-96f7c9cf-blind30-ots
instr:
# agentic-context-engine gives wrong answers across learning, capture conversion and tooling — diagnose without a test suite

This software learns from worked examples: you hand it questions with known-good answers, it judges its own attempts, and it keeps what it learned as reusable lessons it can apply later. You can drive it by hand from a terminal, or over a connection from another program, and you can let it work on its own against a token budget, delegating to nested copies of itself. Nothing about how it is called changed, yet a caller now gets a wrong answer, silence, or an outright failure where the same input used to work. The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits. What follows is everything that was observed from the outside.

Teaching it from worked examples. A plain pass over a couple of question-and-known-answer pairs finishes and hands back one result per example, yet nothing at all is retained afterwards, as if the judging stage had quietly returned no verdict to learn from. Asking a question and then supplying a correction together with the right answer reports that nothing was learned and keeps nothing, while supplying a correction when nothing was ever asked cheerfully reports success. An arrangement that only critiques and revises, with no existing collection handed in, accumulates nothing when run over a single ready-made entry.
